policies.airborneKill: WeaponAccuracy.airborne(owner) at the confirmed final blow

source.officialDescription: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.
source.ddcText: 12 Air Assault Passively grants +10 ↑12 Airborne Effectiveness. On Weapon Kill : +30 ↑32 Airborne Effectiveness per stack for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 stacks. Airborne Kills grant 2 stacks. Additional Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration. Buff is removed on stow.
source.scope: PvE base (non-enhanced); '?' values are not facts, see policies
